title: Meeting at the Busy Corner · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
1. There is / There are 表示“有”。单数用 There is，复数用 There are。例如：There is a café. There are many people. 2. 地点介词：on the corner（在拐角），next to（在……旁边），in front of（在……前面），in the street（在街上）。3. 现在进行时表示正在发生的事：am/is/are + 动词-ing。例如：A woman is buying flowers. Two children are running. 4. 祈使句表示命令或建议，动词原形开头。例如：Don't be late! Let's meet at ten.

There is a new café on the corner. There are many people in the street. A woman is buying flowers. Don't be late!
